title: Gatecrash/Event decks
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Return to Ravnica block event decks)

paragraphs.text: Gatecrash has two bicolored guild -centric event decks .
Boros: Rally and Rout is a red / white intro deck representing the Boros Legion .
The rares in this deck are Clifftop Retreat , Slayers' Stronghold , Ash Zealot , Champion of the Parish , Silverblade Paladin , Spark Trooper , and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben .
Simic: Thrive and Thrash is a green / blue intro deck representing the Simic Combine .
The rares in this deck are Deadeye Navigator , Dungeon Geists , Gruul Ragebeast , Sphinx of Uthuun , Thragtusk , Wolfir Silverheart , and Yeva, Nature's Herald .
